artifact: Independent read-only verification of committed repair tip 063f9d0

overall.one_line_summary: The fresh read-only verifier rejected merge and cleanup because committed 063f9d0 failed clean-checkout portability, projected stale CI state, and used inconsistent rigor grading.
strengths: PR 8 Linux CI passed 319 tests with 9 platform skips.
All real P2 counters remained zero and preflight, D2, D3, and final evaluation remained closed.
The verifier did not edit files, access protected stores, or run measured/preflight commands.
weaknesses: One of four detached clean-checkout regressions failed with seven P2 projection drifts.
Phase, Task, and HANDOFF state had not yet recorded the green Linux recovery.
The initial failure audit used a grade and finding severity outside the rigor contract.

strengths: The verifier inspected committed bytes, the relevant diff, reports, controls, CI, and a fresh checkout.
The portability failure identifies exact files, hashes, outputs, and a repeatable test.
The verdict remains engineering-only and preserves all scientific boundaries.
Each finding links a concrete source to its downstream report or audit contradiction.
The verifier surfaced new blockers after CI green rather than treating green CI as sufficient closeout evidence.

weaknesses: A required committed clean-checkout regression failed, so merge and cleanup were not justified.
suggestions: Repair byte preservation, update recovery reporting, rerun committed clean-checkout tests, and obtain a fresh independent verdict.

findings.observation: Five new hash-bound files checked out with different CRLF bytes and caused seven report drifts.
findings.reasoning: The committed projection was not reproducible from a clean Windows checkout.
findings.suggestion: Add exact -text rules and rerun from a fresh committed checkout.

findings.observation: The reports still described CI recovery as pending after the repair CI passed.
findings.reasoning: Cross-session state would direct later work from stale evidence.
findings.suggestion: Add a recovery audit and regenerate every projection from one read model.

findings.observation: D6 equaled 1 while the grade was Weak Reject, and severity used blocking.
findings.reasoning: The rigor schema requires Reject for any dimension score of 1 and only permits critical, major, minor, or suggestion severities.
findings.suggestion: Correct the review semantics and retain the correction in Git history.
